name: Shoe repair

services.name: Heel replacement
services.story: The main story: new heels for a pair of dress shoes, $35 from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off. Gianni texts READY, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Shoe restoration
services.story: A pair of boots that need restoring, priced at the counter after a look. Nothing is taken. Gianni's written price is OK'd before any work, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Boot resole
services.story: A stitched boot resole, $140. A $40 deposit orders the soles, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter at pick-up.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Hector and Dani (cobblers who make home visits)

services.name: Shoe repair at home
services.story: The main story: a home visit for a pair of boots and a pair of dress shoes. Only the $15 pickup fee is promised, with a card saved for it. Hector prices each item at the visit. The shoes come back Tue Oct 27, and Rosie texts the bill.

services.name: Heel replacement
services.story: New heels, $35 from the list, by a home visit. A card is saved for the $15 pickup fee. The shoes come back Tue Oct 27, and Rosie texts the bill.
